about: Data for the getting-there planner on sophieandjoe2027.com. Every fact has a source key; data/getting-there-sources.md lists each source with its URL and the date it was checked. Drive times are rounded 'about' figures, never promises.

rules.driveTimes: aboutMinutes is the middle of three estimates (Google Maps, OSRM, Valhalla) rounded to the nearest 15 minutes. rangeMinutes is the lowest and highest of the three. None include stops, roadworks or holiday traffic.
rules.drivesEndAt: Drive figures end at the gate: where the public lane meets La Conca's private estate road. Add the estate road (see lastStretch).
rules.flights: UK routes are the ones airlines and airports list in autumn 2026. Summer 2027 schedules aren't out yet, so say 'usually' and check before booking. A route Ryanair's own feed marks as recent is shown as new (isNew), with a check-it-runs note. warn carries a known gap in a route's days over the weekend.
rules.transfers: No transfers are booked. Never promise them.

weekend.ukDifference: Italy is 1 hour ahead of the UK

villas.name: Villa Vallorsaia

definitions.sunset: upper edge of the sun on a flat horizon (-0.833 degrees)
definitions.lastLight: end of civil twilight (sun 6 degrees below the horizon)

sun.note: These are estimates calculated for a flat horizon. Hills on the skyline can hide the sun earlier.

plannerDefaults.note: A rough allowance for passport control, bags and the car hire desk: about 45 minutes, as the planner brief asks. A guess, not a measured figure, so guests can change it.

weekSun.note: Same method and place as Friday's figures, rounded to the minute, for guests arriving on another day.

lastStretch.summary: From the Sansepolcro exit of the E45, follow signs for Rimini through two roundabouts. About 600 m after the second, turn right at the La Conca sign. From there it's about 3 km up into the estate's park.

facts.text: Put La Conca's GPS coordinates in your satnav, not the address
About 1.9 km of narrow lane from the turn-off to the estate gate, mapped as single-track with a 40 km/h limit at the start, and about 400 m mapped as gravel
Then the estate's own private road: about 0.65 km to the La Conca building, about 2.4 km to Villa Santarsa and about 2.7 km to Villa Vallorsaia
It's a steep climb: from about 350 m at the turn-off to about 800 m at the villas, in about 4 km
The estate road may be unmade in places: a guest review on La Conca's Vallorsaia page calls it 'a little bit of a hike through the dirt road'
facts.why: One guest review is the only source; OpenStreetMap tags no surface on the private ways. Hedged until La Conca confirms

facts.text: La Conca's villa pages list free parking and wifi at both villas (the newest copies we could read are from 2022)
Vehicles of up to 20 seats only on the road up: no coaches
An unfamiliar, narrow, steep road is easier in daylight. Friday sunset is estimated at about 20:42, though hills can hide the sun earlier

unknown.text: Phone signal at the villas: we couldn't find a reliable source. Download offline maps for the area before you set off, and save the GPS coordinates

polylines.note: lane: turn-off to gate (OSRM); estate: OSM ways 259236754, 261119415 and 261119529 (private)

publicTransport.summary: Fiddly: the Airlink bus into Perugia, then a coach or bus north to Sansepolcro
publicTransport.notes: Perugia Airlink buses link the airport with Perugia and Assisi stations in about 20 minutes. The railway north to Sansepolcro is being rebuilt and isn't expected to reopen by May 2027, but Sulga's Rome to Ravenna coach calls at Perugia and Sansepolcro, and Busitalia has run replacement buses along the closed line. We couldn't find times for May 2027, so check sulga.it and fsbusitalia.it, then book a taxi ahead for the last few kilometres up to La Conca. A long day with bags, so sharing a hire car is much easier.

publicTransport.summary: Tram into Florence, train to Arezzo, then a bus or taxi
publicTransport.notes: Tram T2 runs from the airport to Piazza dell'Unità Italiana (by Santa Maria Novella station) in about 20 minutes. Regional trains run from Florence to Arezzo; check trenitalia.com for times. From Arezzo, Autolinee Toscane bus SI381 runs to Sansepolcro (check the timetable for your day), then book a taxi ahead for the last few kilometres up to La Conca. A taxi straight from Arezzo is roughly 45 km. A long day with bags, so sharing a hire car is much easier.

publicTransport.summary: Train via Rome Termini and Arezzo, or Sulga's coach to Sansepolcro
publicTransport.notes: The Leonardo Express runs non-stop to Roma Termini in 32 minutes, every 15 minutes. From Termini it's a train north to Arezzo; check trenitalia.com. From Arezzo, Autolinee Toscane bus SI381 runs to Sansepolcro (check the timetable for your day). Or skip Rome: Sulga runs a coach from the airport via Rome and Perugia to Sansepolcro; check sulga.it for times, stops and booking. Either way, book a taxi ahead for the last few kilometres up to La Conca. A taxi straight from Arezzo is roughly 45 km. A long day with bags, so sharing a hire car is much easier.
